findings.root_cause: Auto approval lacks a distinct versioned Host-owned saga transition; PREPARED can currently reach HANDOFF_COMMITTED without decision-bound provenance.
evidence: Auto ALLOW currently reaches HANDOFF_COMMITTED without a decision-bound provenance record.
The resolver requires a durable decision plus handoff evidence, while the current Auto branch skips Skill source preflight.
Reusing the manual SDK decision callback would require fabricating an SDK decision receipt, which is prohibited.

minimal_legal_protocol.preflight_order: Both Auto and Manual execute the same Skill source preflight before either authorization branch can proceed.
minimal_legal_protocol.trusted_constructor: ProductAuthorizationAdapter plus AuthorizationSagaRepository exclusively constructs durable Auto approval provenance; policy code cannot fabricate an authorization receipt.
minimal_legal_protocol.versioned_provenance: Add auto-approved-skill-install-v1 with approval kind, install intent/content/member identity, principal, grant policy generation and fingerprint, full run/call/effect identity, timestamps and expiry covered by the receipt hash.
minimal_legal_protocol.bind_sequence: Auto CAS-binds a Host-owned auto decision before activating the exact grant, then reuses the genuine SDK effect/handoff callback. Manual-v1 remains unchanged.
minimal_legal_protocol.replay_and_concurrency: Identical nonce/version/provenance replays the same receipt; differing candidates conflict; resolver accepts only a fully handoff-committed exact-provenance saga.
minimal_legal_protocol.rollback_and_compatibility: Failure or cancellation revokes the exact grant and cleans the staged intent; historical manual rows and receipt hashes remain byte-compatible.

required_tests: Valid Auto Skill preflights, binds auto-v1 without UI, and resolves only after genuine effect/handoff binding.
Invalid source denies before auto binding and never publishes.
PREPARED or auto-decision-bound without handoff is rejected.
Fabricated or missing auto provenance is rejected.
Concurrent replay and restart return one stable receipt; mismatched digest/policy/principal conflicts.
Manual saga and denial/expiry behavior remain green.
findings.sdk_callback_reuse: Reuse bind_effect_handoff after adding the Auto decision-bound invariant; do not reuse bind_decision for Auto.
findings.ui_automation_rejected: Auto approval cannot synthesize a manual UI decision.

conclusion.summary: Auto approval requires a distinct versioned Host-owned saga transition followed by genuine SDK effect/handoff evidence.
